fact: INSEED's Savanes regional directorate published the Annuaire statistique 2022-2023 de la Région des Savanes in June 2025, built on data collected from administrative sources (19 of 27 institutions and CSOs supplied data, about 70%), with chapters on social security, education, security, justice and health.
title: Annuaire statistique 2022-2023 de la Région des Savanes
